contracts.title: Persist requested intent separately from resolved configuration
contracts.goal: Make lock replay explain exact choices, captures and selected technical edges.
steps: Serialize authored-request digest separately from active/dormant resolved selections and feature closure.
Record exact owner capture/definition, resolution domain/target, induced dependencies and selected capability providers.
Add reader migration/refusal and canonical ordering through existing generated format machinery.
acceptance: Lock round-trip reconstructs requested versus resolved semantics distinctly.
Every induced edge explains its source declaration and consumer intent.

contracts.title: Connect feature and subskill activation to real consumers
contracts.goal: Make selected contributions reach visibility, loading and projection while preserving source bytes.
steps: Carry active feature/subskill exports into effective contribution selection and owning projection consumers.
Preserve full package materialization; activation changes effective contributions only.
Retain dormant branch selections as authored intent while disabling their effects and diagnose removed dormant options.
acceptance: End-to-end fixture observes contribution activation, not only a populated field.
Changing activation leaves captured package bytes unchanged.

contracts.title: Check request freshness before fast paths and expose pure discovery
contracts.goal: Make changed user intent visible before install can report Fresh.
steps: Compute request/definition freshness before bare-install shortcut.
Implement cached choices/catalog discovery through the M-16 service boundary.
Expose candidate definition/effects/defaults without selecting, fetching or writing; explicit preparation remains separate.
acceptance: Discovery purity counters show no authored/cache mutation.

contracts.title: Implement exact reinstall and intent-preserving update
contracts.goal: Distinguish replay from reconfiguration when definitions change.
steps: Route reinstall to exact captures and locked selections without solving or picking defaults.
Keep authored choices during update and produce exact definition/payload/induced-graph diff.
Require explicit reconfiguration for removed options/new required groups; preserve force/assume-yes meanings.
acceptance: Replay/update reports distinguish exact reuse from changed semantic inputs.
No new option is selected as an incidental solver decision.

contracts.title: Make configuration apply and removal recoverable
contracts.goal: Validate whole-world effects before writing and protect shared dependencies.
steps: Build a complete solve/trust/collision/effect plan with captured before-images and request/catalog preconditions.
Apply manifest/lock/owned slot/boot prefixes through the existing journal; report non-reversible hook effects accurately.
For removal recompute desired/reverse closure and distinguish explicit roots/shared dependencies before deleting owned state.
acceptance: Failure injection covers each manifest/lock/slot/boot boundary and retained recovery state.
Removal plan explains affected dependents before any deletion.

contracts.title: Implement attended and unattended choice interaction
contracts.goal: Expose explicit selection through TTY and machine clients without inferred answers.
steps: Build TTY radio/checkbox discovery from the same captured definition/effects model as machine requests.
Require explicit selections or explicit allow-defaults unattended; no JSON/non-TTY prompt and no assume-yes semantic answer.
Expose exact typed NeedsSelection/questions and prepared plan through M-16 operations; save applied intent.
acceptance: CLI/service/MCP produce the same request and prepared effect graph.
Machine invocation completes or returns typed input requirements without waiting on TTY.

reachable_today.finding: Requires.configurations preserves original edge input, source kinds and workspace identity; normalize_input produces existing FeatureInput/ConsumerChoices/typed public parameters. Not execution or lock persistence.

Workspace rich input rejected before migration/Fresh/solve; fetched and in-place common package definitions and transitive rich input rejected before normal apply. Registry/cache acquisition can precede fetched-definition refusal, so not a global no-I/O claim.

Legacy selected active_features persists and is visible. active_deps/dep_features/weak_dep_features/active_subskills are produced/projected in resolver but no production consumer outside that module was found.

Scoped update solves/fetches independently and rebuilds a lock row from new source while retaining old effective features. No common definition/input guard found in actual callees. Legacy v1 to common-config v2 can pass this path without common evaluation; whole update delegates guarded install.

reachable_today.status: separate replay owner, not common support
reachable_today.finding: Reinstall uses locked version/content checks, not original rich configuration; new configured lock writer must not be enabled until this owner reads/guards its meaning. This is not evidence every reinstall currently corrupts records.

missing_seams.finding: Current dependency/forward effects name existing requires entries, while resolution_requires makes all such entries unconditional and Requires has no optional bit. Prototype uses explicit optional declarations. Root must define mandatory versus activatable edges; do not infer optionality from an effect reference or import prototype grammar implicitly.

One real workspace/dependency instance must retain all actual consumers. Add candidate-scoped normalized input and selected definition/content identity through solve, held retry, masked visibility and conditional re-solves; one existing solver, no client-created domains.

Reuse core compile_choices/normalize_input/choice merge and typed parameter validation. App evaluator is not directly generic: hardcoded installer consumer and data-only effect admission; extract/parameterize actual shared responsibility while keeping app adapter behavior. Multi-consumer parameter reconciliation needs real owner evidence.

missing_seams.kind: new durable meaning in existing store
missing_seams.finding: Lock retains effective features and package/source edges, not per-consumer original input, defaults/definition basis or rich selected effects. Extend existing typed lock owner with explicit compatibility before writer activation; preserve intent distinctly from resolved results. Current format.lockfile is schema=none; do not assume app generated DTO can be dropped into core.

Dependency activation and strong/weak forwarding must affect the selected graph; subskills must affect existing effective boot/MCP loading with intact source bytes. Retired install-time copying and empty legacy subskills_active are deliberate, not a request to restore that mechanism.

Freshness precedes current legacy solve; common source is currently refused. Future writer requires request/default-basis freshness before fast paths, exact replay and intent-preserving update, including the separate scoped-update branch and borrowed transaction owners.

Ordinary authored input can be first input carrier, but full contract still requires normal console/external questions and apply/result parity, not the prototype caller-supplied host. Same typed evaluation must feed plan/apply without rereading away answers.

recommended_next_atom.name: Shared unsupported-common admission for scoped package maintenance before effects
recommended_next_atom.status: architecture-ready bounded safety prerequisite; not positive configured-package delivery
recommended_next_atom.why: Normal install already promises explicit refusal; scoped update has an independent reachable bypass. Close it using existing errors and actual selected/candidate manifests before activating any new rich writer. This is correctness, not an easier replacement for solver/effect integration.
prerequisites: Reuse exact existing ConfigurationInputUnsupported / ConfigurationUnsupported errors and preserve value-free diagnostics.

Pre-solve workspace guard and complete selected-candidate guard before confirmation/staging/pruning/hook/boot/lock writes; prospective in-place source must be assessed before materialise_in_place mutates the checkout. If exact prospective metadata is unavailable, refuse honestly before mutation.
Keep ordinary legacy update controls passing; source/cache reads and trace bookkeeping are not project semantic effects and must be reported separately.
recommended_next_atom.user_benefit: A scoped update cannot report success after silently ignoring newly authored/common package choices or a new configured candidate. Existing installation and its lock/boot remain intact on unsupported input.
discriminator: Actual CLI install legacy flow 1.0.0 with authored ^1 constraint from isolated local registry; then add 1.1.0 with valid common configuration and a canary hook. Run scoped update. Expect explicit configuration refusal; assert exact manifest/lock/slot/boot hashes unchanged and hook absent. The current inspected code predicts failure of this oracle; no runtime RED was run.
Add configuration intent only to a sibling workspace requires edge; scoped update must refuse before source solve/effects and not erase or ignore that consumer.

Repeat candidate/transitive and in-place forms at their real pre-effect seam; prove no checkout advance before refusal. Whole update/normal install remain refusal controls; legacy v2 remains successful control.

No decision to use data-only install as the next positive feature

alternatives.data_only: Not recommended as automatic delivery/priority. No current non-app config-value consumer was found beyond declared data and app-specific evaluation. A typed field, lock persistence or inspection alone does not establish the requested cross-kind journey. A data-only slice is legitimate only if root identifies the actual consuming plan/diff/replay contract and it is a necessary shared foundation; cannot bypass A1/A2 for dependency/forward/subskill effects.
alternatives.first_positive_vertical: After A1 is decided, ordinary authored non-app package input→candidate-aware selected effect graph→durable original/resolved record→actual dependency and/or effective loading output, with cold replay/update and no-leak backtracking discriminators. Co-land tightly coupled reader/writer/consumer activation where necessary; do not advertise all kinds/modes from one registry fixture.
